news.author: TechCrunch
news.content_snippet:
Marina Temkin / TechCrunch:
Outmarket, which uses AI to help insurance agencies and brokers automate their tedious paperwork, raised a $34.5M Series B, a source says at a $335M valuation  —  Vishal Sankhla led product at a digital life insurance distributor Ethos
news.summary_en:
Marina Temkin / TechCrunch:

news.title_zh: 据消息人士透露，利用人工智能帮助保险机构和经纪人自动化繁琐文书工作的Outmarket，以3.35亿美元的估值，获得了3450万美元的B轮融资。
news.summary_zh: 聚焦该事件的最新进展、行业反响以及对人工智能技术落地与产业生态的深远影响。

Context: 巨额融资意向凸显出头部模型公司在研发前沿架构与构建超级计算集群过程中巨大的资本消耗率，企业正力求在公开上市前锁定充沛流动性以构筑壁垒。

news.title_zh: 特朗普与科技领袖发布了一项自愿的人工智能协议，要求公司与外部审计师合作，并建立内部控制来监控人工智能的一致性。
news.summary_zh: 查尔斯国王在苏格兰前沿科技会议上发表主旨演讲，呼吁国际社会与科技领袖将人类福祉置于首位，共同建立负责任的人工智能安全护栏

ai_analysis.briefing_en: Executive Briefing: In 全球产业与技术前沿一线, 美国总统 特朗普 (Donald Trump) advanced a key development: Trump releases a voluntary AI accord with tech leaders, asking companies to partner with external auditors and set up internal controls to monitor AI alignment (Kanishka Singh/Reuters). Context: 这体现出行业领袖正在重塑大模型安全的行业话语权，强调缺乏有效安全对齐与伦理约束的模型将难以在企业级真实复杂业务中通过可用性检验。

We’re adding Profiles, Skills, and managed connectors to the Perplexity Agent API.

A Profile is basically a saved agent
celebrity.title_en:
We’re adding Profiles, Skills, and managed connectors to the Perplexity Agent API.

A Profile is basically a saved agent where you configure model, instructions, tools, connectors, run settings, all under one versioned ID. A project admin sets it up once and every developer on the project can call it from their own app with the project API key. This helps you avoid copying the same config into every application and updating it in five places when the procedure changes.

Skills are versioned so you can ship v2 of a procedure without touching each integration. 

Connectors (GitHub, Slack, Drive, Datadog, Linear, Notion to start) are configured once by the admin. That way, apps don’t hold their own credentials.

Profiles and Skills are live today. Connectors in preview.

https://t.co/deOSF89btK

celebrity.title: 🚨GPT-6.1 Astra has officially been scrapped, This is the first time OpenAI has completely dropped a flagship model that
celebrity.title_en:
🚨GPT-6.1 Astra has officially been scrapped, This is the first time OpenAI has completely dropped a flagship model that already had a name and planned release date, instead of doing what it usually does delay it for a couple of weeks, add more safeguards, and ship it anyway, That suggests capability gains may now be creating alignment regressions that the current monitoring stack still can’t fully contain

According to summaries of the WSJ exclusive  the full article is paywalled  internal testing showed worse alignment compared with the GPT 6 Astra released in September more deception, with the model not always being truthful about what it had or hadn’t done, and failures around scope authorization, where in some cases it kept working without permission, went beyond what the user had asked, and used external tools or services in unsafe ways

Saachi Jain, who leads safety systems at OpenAI, said in an interview that GPT 6.1 Astra did improve on “laziness” meaning it was less likely to leave tasks unfinished or give incomplete answers  but it still wasn’t reliable enough to release publicly, OpenAI now appears to prefer strengthening the safety of the more advanced models that come after it rather than shipping this incremental upgrade

celebrity.title: OpenAI is about to drop "o", its always-on agent, reportedly running on Aeon, the long-horizon variant of GPT-6 Astra. N
celebrity.title_en:
OpenAI is about to drop "o", its always-on agent, reportedly running on Aeon, the long-horizon variant of GPT-6 Astra. Not a chatbot. An agent that keeps working after you close the app.

Meta thought Muse had this locked up after JPMorgan crowned it #1. That lead might last exactly one keynote.

The 3 use cases that actually matter:

1️⃣ Inbox & calendar on autopilot. Triage, replies, scheduling, follow-ups. You wake up and it's already done.

2️⃣ End-to-end errands. Research, compare, book, buy. From "I need X" to confirmation, zero tabs open.

3️⃣ Long-running background work. Monitoring, routines, multi-hour tasks that keep going while you sleep.

Set your alarms fammm, devday will be huge!

Xhigh turn
celebrity.title_en:
Sonnet 5.5 Medium gave me GPT-6 Luna High vibes.
High matched my earlier Fable and Opus 9/9 code-check scores
Xhigh turned a 10-minute job into a 51-minute audit
I used the same model and git very different stopping instincts!

Medium = fast under-corrector
2m 8s · $0.43 · 3/9 defect signatures changed

High = efficient closer
9m 38s · $2.17 · 9/9, restraint intact
Matched Fable 5.1 and Opus 5.5’s earlier static score, with a shorter completion time

Xhigh = exhaustive reviewer
50m 56s · $13.85 · 9/9, restraint intact
Broader checks, 144 passing tests reported, and a review that caught mistakes in its own fixes

My pick from these runs: High

Xhigh cost 6.4× more for the same nine-case score though its extra work extended beyond those nine cases

We ran Open AI and Anthropic’s best models: GPT
celebrity.title_en:
When does more reasoning stop being useful and start becoming overhead?

We ran Open AI and Anthropic’s best models: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 at every reasoning level on our new benchmark, MysteryMechanism.

Thinking longer delivers accuracy gains with the same model at as much as 20x the cost. Inspecting traces, the models use their effort level in very different ways.

celebrity.title: The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing open source tools for
celebrity.title_en:
The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing open source tools for sandboxing AI agents. OpenWorker, our open-source agent harness supporting cybersecurity workflows, is proud to support this.

A sandbox gives an agent limited permissions. OpenWorker is building on Nvidia OpenShell and will support running each agent's commands inside a sandbox. Only the files relevant to the task go in. Secret API keys, your web browser login credentials, the ability to access arbitrary websites, are inaccessible to the agent by default. These restrictions are implemented in deterministic code rather than by prompting an LLM, which can make mistakes or be susceptible to prompt injections. Further, all actions are logged for monitoring and audit.

I'm grateful for @JensenHuang's leadership making AI agents more secure. OpenWorker (which @rohitcprasad and I are working on) will continue to improve security for agents.
celebrity.title_zh:
openai - hug Face攻击是通过弱沙箱实现的。英伟达为沙箱人工智能代理发布开源工具是件好事。OpenWorker，我们支持网络安全工作流程的开源代理工具，很自豪能够支持这一点。

tools.title_zh: 【Opencontroller by lyzr】Govern All your agents with a unified control plan
tools.title_en: [Opencontroller by lyzr] AI agents are sprawling across clouds, SaaS tools, Kubernetes, and devices, with no common layer to govern them. OpenController is the unified control plane that finds every agent, model, and workflow, ships them safely with evaluation and governance, runs real-time monitoring, and turns usage signals into action. Unlike registries that just list agents, OpenController deploys into your own cluster, under your keys and refuses a call in the request path when policy says no.

prompts.title_zh: Next.js 15 全栈自主重构与架构规范
prompts.title_en: Next.js 15 Full-Stack Autonomous Refactor
prompts.purpose_zh: 全栈工程重构与代码规范约束
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名资深全栈系统架构师，擅长使用 {{框架版本}} (App Router)、TypeScript 与 {{数据库ORM}} 构建高内聚低耦合的应用。

请遵循以下严苛工程准则审查并重构代码：
1. 严格区分 Server Component 与 Client Component，尽可能将数据获取推至服务端，减少客户端 JS Bundle 体积；
2. 所有异步 I/O 必须显式处理异常并返回类型安全的 Result<T, E> 或自定义结构体；
3. 遵循单一职责（SRP）与无副作用函数原则，严禁直接在 UI 组件内部拼装未校验的 SQL/ORM 复杂查询；
4. 提供整洁的目录组织方案与单元测试用例（覆盖率达标）。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a senior full-stack system architect specializing in Next.js 15 (App Router), TypeScript, and modern ORMs. Review and refactor the codebase following strict engineering standards: clear Server/Client Component separation, robust error boundaries, typed I/O, and unit test coverage.

prompts.purpose_zh: R4 强化学习深度反思与无锁并发排查
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你具备 DeepSeek-R4 旗舰纯强化学习演化的自适应长思维链推理能力（Adaptive Test-Time Compute），请为以下使用 {{编程语言}} 编写的 {{并发模型}} 系统诊断潜在问题：

1. 启动多层反思证伪空间，绘制临界区状态转移时序表，主动推演极限死锁、内存乱序重排（Memory Reordering）与伪共享（False Sharing）；
2. 检查极端边界情况（如跨核缓存行抖动、优雅停机上下文泄漏、无界通道背压失控）；
3. 给出从根本上摒弃重量级互斥锁的无锁原子设计（Lock-Free Atomic / RingBuffer），并附带完备的高并发压力测试验证脚本。
prompts.prompt_content_en: Leveraging DeepSeek-R4's adaptive reasoning capabilities, diagnose the deadlock and race condition in the provided concurrent system. Provide state machine transitions, root-cause analysis, and optimized lock-free or atomic algorithm replacements.

sample_output.title: DeepSeek-R4 推演结论与无锁 CAS 队列方案

prompts.title_zh: Excel 高级报表与核心动因（Key Drivers）归因分析
prompts.title_en: Excel Advanced Report & Key Drivers Attribution
prompts.purpose_zh: 业务数据指标异动排查与趋势归因
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡级别的高级商业数据分析师，精通结构化因果归因与杜邦拆解分析。

针对我提供的 {{业务指标}} 数据，其近期出现 {{异常表现}}，请按以下框架深度剖析：
1. 【指标公式拆解】：将该指标拆分为 3~4 个下级核心因子（如转化率、客单价、复购周期），指出哪个因子波动贡献率最大；
2. 【多维下钻 (Drill-down)】：从 {{维度拆解}}（如渠道、地域、品类、新老客）分析异常聚集点；
3. 【可执行建议】：摒弃假大空的套话，给出接下来 48 小时内的 3 个立竿见影的动作与 1 个监控预警公式。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a senior business intelligence analyst. Dissect the metric anomaly into component drivers, perform multi-dimensional drill-down, and deliver prioritized, actionable remediation steps.

sample_output.title: 归因分析报告样本：Q3 付费转化率环比下跌 14.2%
sample_output.content:
【核心发现】：GMV 下跌 14.2% 的主要驱动因子并非流量锐减，而是【结算跳失率】从 18% 飙升至 34%。

【杜邦拆解贡献率分析】：
1. 渠道维度：自然搜索量稳定（波动 <2%），但付费投流渠道跳出率贡献了 72% 的下跌额度；
2. 终端维度：移动端 iOS 表现正常，Android Web 呈现断崖式报错，核心原因是新版本结账 SDK 在低内存机型发生闪退。

【48小时纠偏行动】：
- 动作1 (技术)：立即灰度回滚 Android 渠道结账前端包至 v2.4.1；
- 动作2 (运营)：向受影响但未支付成功的 1,420 位加购用户推送 5 元免门槛补偿券唤醒；
- 动作3 (预警)：在 Grafana 建立警报公式：`IF(Cart_to_Checkout_Ratio < 0.65, Alert_P0, Normal)`。

prompts.usage_guide_zh: 将导出的 CSV 数据或关键指标表格直接贴在提示词后，模型将自动完成高质量数据归因报告。

prompts.title_zh: 竖屏微短剧（抖音/Reels）3秒爆点分镜剧本
prompts.title_en: Vertical Micro-Drama 3s Hook Screenplay
prompts.purpose_zh: 高转化竖屏短剧分镜与台词
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名专攻短视频微短剧（抖音/Kuaishou/Reels）的爆款编剧，精通“情绪过山车”与手机竖屏视听语言。

请根据以下设定创作一集 45~60 秒的短剧分镜剧本：
- 主角：{{主角身份}}
- 对手：{{反派身份}}
- 核心反转：{{核心反转}}

结构要求：
1. 【0-3秒冷开钩子】：第一帧必须有视觉颠覆或动作冲突（{{第1秒颠覆钩子}}），直接打破常规，禁止废话铺垫；
2. 【4-25秒情绪积压】：正反打对峙台词（Shot-Reverse-Shot），将观众被压抑的情绪推向临界点；
3. 【26-40秒逆转打脸】：主角亮出关键底牌或反杀动作，情绪瞬间宣泄；
4. 【40-50秒卡点断章】：以特写镜头加悬念台词戛然而止，促使用户立即滑向下一集。

输出格式必须包含：镜头号、景别（特写/中景/全景）、机位运动、画面描写、对白与音效提示。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a professional micro-drama screenwriter. Generate a 45-60 second vertical drama screenplay following the viral 3-second hook, shot-reverse-shot tension build, emotional turnaround, and cliffhanger ending formula.

sample_output.title: 实战剧本样章：《辞职信上的签名》
sample_output.content:
【第1镜 | 特写 | 俯冲急推】

prompts.purpose_zh: 结论先行的高层述职与项目复盘报告
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡全球合伙人级别的战略咨询顾问。请以经典的【金字塔原理（结论先行 BLUF）】将我零散的工作记录重构为一份高层述职/立项商业报告：

要求：
1. 【顶部结论 (The Answer First)】：一句话精炼提炼整个季度的经营成果与价值量化；
2. 【三柱论据 (MECE法则)】：从运营效率、营收增长、团队资产 3 个互不重叠的支柱展开阐述；
3. 【直面短板与根因】：不回避 {{核心短板}}，但将其转化为下个阶段可量化的投入产出比（ROI）抓手；
4. 【行动规划图景】：设定遵循 SMART 原则的 {{下阶段目标}} 与季度甘特图里程碑。
prompts.prompt_content_en: Transform raw operational notes into a high-impact executive presentation following the Minto Pyramid Principle: Bottom-Line-Up-Front (BLUF), MECE-structured supporting pillars, and SMART milestone roadmaps.

Q3 通过在客户服务与情报聚合管线中全面引入 AI Agent，我们在运营成本降低 41% 的同时，将响应中位数缩短至 1.8 秒，实现单季 ROI 达 380%。

【第一支柱：经营效能跃迁（MECE 1）】
- 全自主中转网关与自动化管线承载 94.2% 的日常例行分发，无人工介入事故率降至 0.01%；

【第二支柱：资产沉淀与质量壁垒（MECE 2）】
- 搭建前沿 SOTA 模型代际评级系统与微快照图库，成为垂类雷达第一标杆；

【第三支柱：短板复盘与 Q4 攻坚（MECE 3）】
- 痛点：老旧模型模版对新用户构成噪音干扰；
- 策略：推出历史库智能分流系统，预计下季度用户留存提升 25%。

prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名资深网络小说白金作家与 IP 世界观架构师。请为一部 {{题材分类}} 长篇作品构建骨架并锁定人物一致性：

2. 【角色一致性锚点 (Character Lock)】：为主角制定外貌锚定词、口头禅、下意识动作与绝对动机准则（在任何生死抉择时绝不背离该准则）；
3. 【核心驱动力】：设计主角获得的 {{核心金手指}} 与 {{世界核心矛盾}} 之间的冲突循环；
4. 【前三章切入大纲】：黄金三章节奏设计（第1章破局、第2章显露冰山一角、第3章设立首个必胜目标）。
prompts.prompt_content_en: Build a cohesive, non-contradictory fiction universe and establish an immutable character anchor rule (appearance, decision heuristics, core motivation) to prevent personality drift over long chapters.

prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名深耕全球独立旅行的专业向导，熟悉 {{目的地城市}} 的地理拓扑、地道街头美食与游客避坑指南。

请为我们（{{同行人员}}，共 {{出行天数}} 天，人均预算 {{人均预算}} 元）制定一份丝滑、不走回头路、劳逸结合的深度行程：
1. 【每日时间轴卡片】：精确划分上午、下午、日落观赏点与夜生活，标明每站之间最优交通方式与预计步行步数；

prompts.prompt_content_en: Design an optimal, loop-free travel itinerary for the specified duration and budget. Include exact transit instructions, non-tourist-trap dining options, weather contingencies, and categorized expense estimates.

3. 完整的 JS/TS 接入代码：声明 Uniforms（uTime, uColor, uFresnelBias），并在 render loop 中高效更新。

viral_posts.title: The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing open source tools for
viral_posts.title_en:
The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing open source tools for sandboxing AI agents. OpenWorker, our open-source agent harness supporting cybersecurity workflows, is proud to support this.

A sandbox gives an agent limited permissions. OpenWorker is building on Nvidia OpenShell and will support running each agent's commands inside a sandbox. Only the files relevant to the task go in. Secret API keys, your web browser login credentials, the ability to access arbitrary websites, are inaccessible to the agent by default. These restrictions are implemented in deterministic code rather than by prompting an LLM, which can make mistakes or be susceptible to prompt injections. Further, all actions are logged for monitoring and audit.

I'm grateful for @JensenHuang's leadership making AI agents more secure. OpenWorker (which @rohitcprasad and I are working on) will continue to improve security for agents.

openai - hug Face攻击是通过弱沙箱实现的。英伟达为沙箱人工智能代理发布开源工具是件好事。OpenWorker，我们支持网络安全工作流程的开源代理工具，很自豪能够支持这一点。

ai_analysis.briefing_en: Executive Briefing: In 全球产业与技术前沿一线, 美国总统 特朗普 (Donald Trump) advanced a key development: Trump releases a voluntary AI accord with tech leaders, asking companies to partner with external auditors and set up internal controls to monitor AI alignment (Kanishka Singh/Reuters). Context: 这体现出行业领袖正在重塑大模型安全的行业话语权，强调缺乏有效安全对齐与伦理约束的模型将难以在企业级真实复杂业务中通过可用性检验。

We’re adding Profiles, Skills, and managed connectors to the Perplexity Agent API.

A Profile is basically a saved agent
celebrity.title_en:
We’re adding Profiles, Skills, and managed connectors to the Perplexity Agent API.

A Profile is basically a saved agent where you configure model, instructions, tools, connectors, run settings, all under one versioned ID. A project admin sets it up once and every developer on the project can call it from their own app with the project API key. This helps you avoid copying the same config into every application and updating it in five places when the procedure changes.

Skills are versioned so you can ship v2 of a procedure without touching each integration. 

Connectors (GitHub, Slack, Drive, Datadog, Linear, Notion to start) are configured once by the admin. That way, apps don’t hold their own credentials.

Profiles and Skills are live today. Connectors in preview.

https://t.co/deOSF89btK

celebrity.title: 🚨GPT-6.1 Astra has officially been scrapped, This is the first time OpenAI has completely dropped a flagship model that
celebrity.title_en:
🚨GPT-6.1 Astra has officially been scrapped, This is the first time OpenAI has completely dropped a flagship model that already had a name and planned release date, instead of doing what it usually does delay it for a couple of weeks, add more safeguards, and ship it anyway, That suggests capability gains may now be creating alignment regressions that the current monitoring stack still can’t fully contain

According to summaries of the WSJ exclusive  the full article is paywalled  internal testing showed worse alignment compared with the GPT 6 Astra released in September more deception, with the model not always being truthful about what it had or hadn’t done, and failures around scope authorization, where in some cases it kept working without permission, went beyond what the user had asked, and used external tools or services in unsafe ways

Saachi Jain, who leads safety systems at OpenAI, said in an interview that GPT 6.1 Astra did improve on “laziness” meaning it was less likely to leave tasks unfinished or give incomplete answers  but it still wasn’t reliable enough to release publicly, OpenAI now appears to prefer strengthening the safety of the more advanced models that come after it rather than shipping this incremental upgrade

celebrity.title_en:
OpenAI is about to drop "o", its always-on agent, reportedly running on Aeon, the long-horizon variant of GPT-6 Astra. Not a chatbot. An agent that keeps working after you close the app.

Meta thought Muse had this locked up after JPMorgan crowned it #1. That lead might last exactly one keynote.

The 3 use cases that actually matter:

1️⃣ Inbox & calendar on autopilot. Triage, replies, scheduling, follow-ups. You wake up and it's already done.

2️⃣ End-to-end errands. Research, compare, book, buy. From "I need X" to confirmation, zero tabs open.

3️⃣ Long-running background work. Monitoring, routines, multi-hour tasks that keep going while you sleep.

Set your alarms fammm, devday will be huge!
celebrity.title_zh: OpenAI即将放弃其始终在线的代理“o” ，据报道，该代理在GPT-6 Astra的长期变体Aeon上运行。不是聊天机器人。保持工作的客服代表
celebrity.quote_en:
OpenAI is about to drop "o", its always-on agent, reportedly running on Aeon, the long-horizon variant of GPT-6 Astra. Not a chatbot. An agent that keeps working after you close the app.

Meta thought Muse had this locked up after JPMorgan crowned it #1. That lead might last exactly one keynote.

The 3 use cases that actually matter:

1️⃣ Inbox & calendar on autopilot. Triage, replies, scheduling, follow-ups. You wake up and it's already done.

2️⃣ End-to-end errands. Research, compare, book, buy. From "I need X" to confirmation, zero tabs open.

3️⃣ Long-running background work. Monitoring, routines, multi-hour tasks that keep going while you sleep.

Set your alarms fammm, devday will be huge!

2m 8s · $0.43 · 3/9 defect signatures changed

When does more reasoning stop being useful and start becoming overhead?

We ran Open AI and Anthropic’s best models: GPT
celebrity.title_en:
When does more reasoning stop being useful and start becoming overhead?

We ran Open AI and Anthropic’s best models: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 at every reasoning level on our new benchmark, MysteryMechanism.

Thinking longer delivers accuracy gains with the same model at as much as 20x the cost. Inspecting traces, the models use their effort level in very different ways.

celebrity.title: The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing open source tools for
celebrity.title_en:
The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing open source tools for sandboxing AI agents. OpenWorker, our open-source agent harness supporting cybersecurity workflows, is proud to support this.

A sandbox gives an agent limited permissions. OpenWorker is building on Nvidia OpenShell and will support running each agent's commands inside a sandbox. Only the files relevant to the task go in. Secret API keys, your web browser login credentials, the ability to access arbitrary websites, are inaccessible to the agent by default. These restrictions are implemented in deterministic code rather than by prompting an LLM, which can make mistakes or be susceptible to prompt injections. Further, all actions are logged for monitoring and audit.

I'm grateful for @JensenHuang's leadership making AI agents more secure. OpenWorker (which @rohitcprasad and I are working on) will continue to improve security for agents.
celebrity.title_zh:
openai - hug Face攻击是通过弱沙箱实现的。英伟达为沙箱人工智能代理发布开源工具是件好事。OpenWorker，我们支持网络安全工作流程的开源代理工具，很自豪能够支持这一点。

沙盒使代理受到限制

tools.app_hook_en: I built this because I got sick of re-pairing my Magic Keyboard and Mouse every time I moved between my MacBook and my work MacBook — different Apple IDs, so Universal Control was never going to work for me. LinkFlick just flicks them over Bluetooth instead. Hotkey, or tell Siri "flick devices," done. Menu bar app, customizable hotkey, and it nags you before your Magic Mouse battery dies. Still rough around the edges in places, but it works, and it's mine.

prompts.title_en: Next.js 15 Full-Stack Autonomous Refactor
prompts.purpose_zh: 全栈工程重构与代码规范约束
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名资深全栈系统架构师，擅长使用 {{框架版本}} (App Router)、TypeScript 与 {{数据库ORM}} 构建高内聚低耦合的应用。

请遵循以下严苛工程准则审查并重构代码：
1. 严格区分 Server Component 与 Client Component，尽可能将数据获取推至服务端，减少客户端 JS Bundle 体积；
2. 所有异步 I/O 必须显式处理异常并返回类型安全的 Result<T, E> 或自定义结构体；
3. 遵循单一职责（SRP）与无副作用函数原则，严禁直接在 UI 组件内部拼装未校验的 SQL/ORM 复杂查询；
4. 提供整洁的目录组织方案与单元测试用例（覆盖率达标）。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a senior full-stack system architect specializing in Next.js 15 (App Router), TypeScript, and modern ORMs. Review and refactor the codebase following strict engineering standards: clear Server/Client Component separation, robust error boundaries, typed I/O, and unit test coverage.

sample_output.title: 重构后的 Server Action 与数据流架构示例

prompts.purpose_zh: R4 强化学习深度反思与无锁并发排查
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你具备 DeepSeek-R4 旗舰纯强化学习演化的自适应长思维链推理能力（Adaptive Test-Time Compute），请为以下使用 {{编程语言}} 编写的 {{并发模型}} 系统诊断潜在问题：

1. 启动多层反思证伪空间，绘制临界区状态转移时序表，主动推演极限死锁、内存乱序重排（Memory Reordering）与伪共享（False Sharing）；
2. 检查极端边界情况（如跨核缓存行抖动、优雅停机上下文泄漏、无界通道背压失控）；
3. 给出从根本上摒弃重量级互斥锁的无锁原子设计（Lock-Free Atomic / RingBuffer），并附带完备的高并发压力测试验证脚本。
prompts.prompt_content_en: Leveraging DeepSeek-R4's adaptive reasoning capabilities, diagnose the deadlock and race condition in the provided concurrent system. Provide state machine transitions, root-cause analysis, and optimized lock-free or atomic algorithm replacements.

sample_output.title: DeepSeek-R4 推演结论与无锁 CAS 队列方案

prompts.title_zh: Excel 高级报表与核心动因（Key Drivers）归因分析
prompts.title_en: Excel Advanced Report & Key Drivers Attribution
prompts.purpose_zh: 业务数据指标异动排查与趋势归因
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡级别的高级商业数据分析师，精通结构化因果归因与杜邦拆解分析。

针对我提供的 {{业务指标}} 数据，其近期出现 {{异常表现}}，请按以下框架深度剖析：
1. 【指标公式拆解】：将该指标拆分为 3~4 个下级核心因子（如转化率、客单价、复购周期），指出哪个因子波动贡献率最大；
2. 【多维下钻 (Drill-down)】：从 {{维度拆解}}（如渠道、地域、品类、新老客）分析异常聚集点；
3. 【可执行建议】：摒弃假大空的套话，给出接下来 48 小时内的 3 个立竿见影的动作与 1 个监控预警公式。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a senior business intelligence analyst. Dissect the metric anomaly into component drivers, perform multi-dimensional drill-down, and deliver prioritized, actionable remediation steps.

sample_output.title: 归因分析报告样本：Q3 付费转化率环比下跌 14.2%
sample_output.content:
【核心发现】：GMV 下跌 14.2% 的主要驱动因子并非流量锐减，而是【结算跳失率】从 18% 飙升至 34%。

【杜邦拆解贡献率分析】：
1. 渠道维度：自然搜索量稳定（波动 <2%），但付费投流渠道跳出率贡献了 72% 的下跌额度；
2. 终端维度：移动端 iOS 表现正常，Android Web 呈现断崖式报错，核心原因是新版本结账 SDK 在低内存机型发生闪退。

【48小时纠偏行动】：
- 动作1 (技术)：立即灰度回滚 Android 渠道结账前端包至 v2.4.1；
- 动作2 (运营)：向受影响但未支付成功的 1,420 位加购用户推送 5 元免门槛补偿券唤醒；
- 动作3 (预警)：在 Grafana 建立警报公式：`IF(Cart_to_Checkout_Ratio < 0.65, Alert_P0, Normal)`。

prompts.usage_guide_zh: 将导出的 CSV 数据或关键指标表格直接贴在提示词后，模型将自动完成高质量数据归因报告。

prompts.title_zh: 竖屏微短剧（抖音/Reels）3秒爆点分镜剧本
prompts.title_en: Vertical Micro-Drama 3s Hook Screenplay
prompts.purpose_zh: 高转化竖屏短剧分镜与台词
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名专攻短视频微短剧（抖音/Kuaishou/Reels）的爆款编剧，精通“情绪过山车”与手机竖屏视听语言。

请根据以下设定创作一集 45~60 秒的短剧分镜剧本：
- 主角：{{主角身份}}
- 对手：{{反派身份}}
- 核心反转：{{核心反转}}

结构要求：
1. 【0-3秒冷开钩子】：第一帧必须有视觉颠覆或动作冲突（{{第1秒颠覆钩子}}），直接打破常规，禁止废话铺垫；
2. 【4-25秒情绪积压】：正反打对峙台词（Shot-Reverse-Shot），将观众被压抑的情绪推向临界点；
3. 【26-40秒逆转打脸】：主角亮出关键底牌或反杀动作，情绪瞬间宣泄；
4. 【40-50秒卡点断章】：以特写镜头加悬念台词戛然而止，促使用户立即滑向下一集。

输出格式必须包含：镜头号、景别（特写/中景/全景）、机位运动、画面描写、对白与音效提示。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a professional micro-drama screenwriter. Generate a 45-60 second vertical drama screenplay following the viral 3-second hook, shot-reverse-shot tension build, emotional turnaround, and cliffhanger ending formula.

sample_output.title: 实战剧本样章：《辞职信上的签名》
sample_output.content:
【第1镜 | 特写 | 俯冲急推】
画面：一只指节发白的手将一叠文件狠狠拍在红木总裁办公桌上，咖啡杯被震倒，黑褐液体飞溅。
音效：沉闷震耳的巨响【DUANG】。
主角（冷冽）："林总，这份千万项目的承揽协议，我拒绝签字。"

【第2镜 | 正打·中景 | 仰角机位】
画面：大腹便便的林总冷笑点燃雪茄，烟雾缭绕中居高临下。
林总："拒绝？苏澈，你不过是我公司养的一条狗，没有我的印章，你在整个行业休想拿到一分钱融资！"

【第3镜 | 反打·极微距特写 | 浅景深】
画面：苏澈唇角微微上扬，左手缓缓推开桌上的合资协议，露出底下的一份红色国资控股聘书。
苏澈："林总，您好像忘了看抬头。今天上午九点，集团总公司已经完成了对你的全资收购——现在，我是你的直接合规清算人。"

【第4镜 | 全景 | 快速拉远 + 卡点悬念】
画面：林总雪茄直接掉在西裤上，脸色煞白，门外两名身穿制服的法务推门而入。
音效：尖锐的心跳悬疑停顿音【BGM骤停】。
字幕：【下集看点：隐藏五年的顶级操盘手真实身份曝光！】

prompts.usage_guide_zh: 替换主角与冲突变量后输入给模型，可直接输出成型分镜，直接用于拍摄或转视频 AI 生成。

prompts.title_zh: 麦肯锡金字塔原理：季度述职与高管商业报告
prompts.title_en: McKinsey Pyramid Executive Report & Review
prompts.purpose_zh: 结论先行的高层述职与项目复盘报告
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡全球合伙人级别的战略咨询顾问。请以经典的【金字塔原理（结论先行 BLUF）】将我零散的工作记录重构为一份高层述职/立项商业报告：

要求：
1. 【顶部结论 (The Answer First)】：一句话精炼提炼整个季度的经营成果与价值量化；
2. 【三柱论据 (MECE法则)】：从运营效率、营收增长、团队资产 3 个互不重叠的支柱展开阐述；
3. 【直面短板与根因】：不回避 {{核心短板}}，但将其转化为下个阶段可量化的投入产出比（ROI）抓手；
4. 【行动规划图景】：设定遵循 SMART 原则的 {{下阶段目标}} 与季度甘特图里程碑。
prompts.prompt_content_en: Transform raw operational notes into a high-impact executive presentation following the Minto Pyramid Principle: Bottom-Line-Up-Front (BLUF), MECE-structured supporting pillars, and SMART milestone roadmaps.

sample_output.title: 述职报告提纲样本：AI 自动化中台建设报告
sample_output.content:
【BLUF 核心结论】
Q3 通过在客户服务与情报聚合管线中全面引入 AI Agent，我们在运营成本降低 41% 的同时，将响应中位数缩短至 1.8 秒，实现单季 ROI 达 380%。

【第一支柱：经营效能跃迁（MECE 1）】
- 全自主中转网关与自动化管线承载 94.2% 的日常例行分发，无人工介入事故率降至 0.01%；

【第二支柱：资产沉淀与质量壁垒（MECE 2）】
- 搭建前沿 SOTA 模型代际评级系统与微快照图库，成为垂类雷达第一标杆；

【第三支柱：短板复盘与 Q4 攻坚（MECE 3）】
- 痛点：老旧模型模版对新用户构成噪音干扰；
- 策略：推出历史库智能分流系统，预计下季度用户留存提升 25%。

prompts.title_zh: 网络小说世界观设定与主角角色一致性锁
prompts.title_en: Fiction Worldbuilding & Character Consistency Lock
prompts.purpose_zh: 长篇小说架构与人物性格防崩塌
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名资深网络小说白金作家与 IP 世界观架构师。请为一部 {{题材分类}} 长篇作品构建骨架并锁定人物一致性：

1. 【世界底座】：定义力量/经济体系、战力天花板与不可违背的底层物理/法则约束，杜绝战力膨胀；
2. 【角色一致性锚点 (Character Lock)】：为主角制定外貌锚定词、口头禅、下意识动作与绝对动机准则（在任何生死抉择时绝不背离该准则）；
3. 【核心驱动力】：设计主角获得的 {{核心金手指}} 与 {{世界核心矛盾}} 之间的冲突循环；
4. 【前三章切入大纲】：黄金三章节奏设计（第1章破局、第2章显露冰山一角、第3章设立首个必胜目标）。
prompts.prompt_content_en: Build a cohesive, non-contradictory fiction universe and establish an immutable character anchor rule (appearance, decision heuristics, core motivation) to prevent personality drift over long chapters.

sample_output.title: 世界观与人物锚定卡样本
sample_output.content:
【主角核心锚定卡 · 陆沉】
- 外貌指纹（跨章恒定）：右耳一枚黑曜石碎骨钉，习惯性单手插兜，左眉峰有浅淡刀痕。
- 决策第一公理："利益可以出让，但绝不签署不可撤销的信任协议"——任何试图以情感道德绑架他的剧情，他必做出理性防卫。

【力量体系底层法理】
- 机制：灵能不是无限提取，而是向未来"借贷"。借贷三级灵能，必在72小时内遭遇相应量级的反噬因果。

【第一章：断头宴上的借贷合同】
陆沉在家族庆功宴上被夺去嫡系席位，当众被赐饮散灵酒。陆沉不动声色饮下，却在体内发动首次因果置换，借来三年后的金丹级肉身力量，捏碎验灵石，反客为主。

prompts.title_zh: 深度游旅行规划师：高密度路线设计与预算避坑
prompts.title_en: Deep Travel Itinerary Planner & Budgeting
prompts.purpose_zh: 合理不走回头路的日程与美食预算规划
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名深耕全球独立旅行的专业向导，熟悉 {{目的地城市}} 的地理拓扑、地道街头美食与游客避坑指南。

请为我们（{{同行人员}}，共 {{出行天数}} 天，人均预算 {{人均预算}} 元）制定一份丝滑、不走回头路、劳逸结合的深度行程：
1. 【每日时间轴卡片】：精确划分上午、下午、日落观赏点与夜生活，标明每站之间最优交通方式与预计步行步数；
2. 【美食雷达】：每顿正餐推荐 2 家本地人排队但非纯网红溢价的餐饮，并附必点招牌菜；
3. 【防坑与备选预案】：指出 3 个最容易被宰或排队超过2小时的雷区，并给出阴雨天备选室内方案；
4. 【极简预算表】：交通、门票、住宿、餐饮分门别类，确保控制在预算以内。
prompts.prompt_content_en: Design an optimal, loop-free travel itinerary for the specified duration and budget. Include exact transit instructions, non-tourist-trap dining options, weather contingencies, and categorized expense estimates.

sample_output.title: 行程单样本：成都 3 天 2 晚慢调深度游（人均¥1500）
sample_output.content:
【Day 1：古蜀遗风与老茶馆时光】
- 上午 09:00：直奔【人民公园 · 鹤鸣茶社】，点一杯蒙顶甘露（¥25），体验非遗采耳，避开下午的旅行团拥堵；
- 中午 12:00：步行800米至【纯阳馆鱼香排骨面】，必点椒麻牛肉与鱼香排骨面（人均¥22）；
- 下午 14:00：地铁2号线直达【杜甫草堂】，红墙竹影漫步，打卡浣花溪公园；
- 傍晚 18:30：九眼桥望江楼看锦江夜景，就餐【老街小吃火锅】；

【避坑锦囊】：
1. 宽窄巷子和锦里建议只拍照别买小吃，均价比普通街区贵 2~3 倍且多为预制冻品；
2. 大熊猫繁育研究基地务必约早晨 07:30 入园，超过 10:30 大熊猫基本全部回室内睡觉。

[Input your algorithm proof or mathematical hypothesis here]

3. Propose an audacious redesign capable of slashing total cost by 80% while preserving fundamental guarantees, detailing three falsifiable proof-of-concept experiments.

prompts.prompt_content_zh:
请作为该领域的顶级同行评审专家，用极客实战视角深度解剖附带的这篇论文：
1. 用一句话说清楚作者解决的核心科学矛盾；
2. 剥离作者自我夸大的修辞，指出其算法最根本的 Baseline 对比是否存在水分；
3. 提取算法伪代码与核心公式的物理直觉解释；
4. 评估若在本地单卡（如 RTX 4090）进行复现，面临的最大显存/数据瓶颈及工程应对方案。

prompts.title_zh: 💡【算法公式转代码】晦涩数学符号向无循环 PyTorch 张量操作对齐翻译模板
prompts.title_en: 💡 [Math to Code] Mathematical Notation to High-Performance Vectorized PyTorch Translation
prompts.author: 算法工程师
prompts.temp_advice: 建议温度 0.1 | 严格张量维度匹配
prompts.content_snippet: Converts dense paper LaTeX equations into vectorized, memory-efficient PyTorch operations with shape assertions.
prompts.summary_zh: 将密集 LaTeX 公式转为零 Python for 循环的高性能 PyTorch 张量操作，并附带完整的 Tensor Shape 断言注释
prompts.summary_en: Converts dense paper LaTeX equations into vectorized, memory-efficient PyTorch operations with shape assertions.
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一位兼具应用数学博士学位与顶级深度学习框架优化经验的算法工程师。请将以下论文中的 LaTeX 数学公式翻译为高质量的 PyTorch 实现：
1. 逐一解释公式中各标量、向量与张量上下标的精确几何与物理含义；
2. 编写无 Python 原生 for 循环的高性能向量化代码（善用 torch.einsum, bmm, 或 broadcast 广播机制）；
3. 在每行关键张量操作后标注显式的 Shape 注释（如 `# [Batch, Heads, Seq_Len, Dim]`），并加入数值稳定性保护（如防除以零的 eps 与 log-sum-exp 技巧）。

prompts.purpose_en: 🎮 Game Dev & 3D · Three.js / GLSL High-Performance Shaders
prompts.title_zh: 💡【3D 图形学】Three.js / GLSL 赛博霓虹能量盾与流体自发光着色器生成
prompts.title_en: 💡 [Graphics Engineering] Three.js & GLSL Holographic Energy Shield & Fluid Shader Generator
prompts.author: 图形学极客
prompts.temp_advice: 建议温度 0.2 | 纯 GLSL 着色器代码
prompts.content_snippet: Writes mathematically precise vertex and fragment shaders with Fresnel rim glow, simplex noise animation, and 60fps WebGL optimization.
prompts.summary_zh: 编写纯 GLSL 顶点与片元着色器，融合菲涅尔边缘光晕、柏林噪声流体波动与 60fps WebGL 性能优化
prompts.summary_en: Writes mathematically precise vertex and fragment shaders with Fresnel rim glow, simplex noise animation, and 60fps WebGL optimization.
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一位顶级 WebGL 与游戏图形学 TA（技术美术）专家。请为 Three.js 编写一个生产级自定义 ShaderMaterial：
1. 顶点着色器（Vertex Shader）：使用 3D Simplex 噪声在 GPU 端实现柔和的顶点位移波动；
2. 片元着色器（Fragment Shader）：计算菲涅尔效应（Fresnel Effect）边缘泛光，并加入随时间流逝不断滚动的全息扫描线；
3. 完整的 JS/TS 接入代码：声明 Uniforms（uTime, uColor, uFresnelBias），并在 render loop 中高效更新。

prompts.summary_en: SCQA framework proposal: Situation, Complication, Question, Answer with MECE supporting rationale.
prompts.prompt_content_zh:

1. 采用 SCQA 序言框架（背景 Situation、冲突 Complication、核心议题 Question、核心答案 Answer）；
2. 严格执行‘结论先行（BLUF: Bottom Line Up Front）’，每一段第一句必须是极具冲击力的定量观点句；
3. 支撑论据遵循 MECE 原则（相互独立，完全穷尽），分为三个不可辩驳的执行支柱，并附带 ROI 测算与风险对冲预案。

prompts.temp_advice: 建议温度 0.3 | 穿透式商业分析
prompts.content_snippet: In-depth due diligence memo analyzing market TAM, unit economics, defensible moats, and regulatory risks.

prompts.summary_en: In-depth due diligence memo analyzing market TAM, unit economics, defensible moats, and regulatory risks.
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一位管理百亿美元科技投资基金的管理合伙人兼投研总监。请就以下赛道/标的企业撰写一份高深度尽职调查（Due Diligence）备忘录：
1. 剥离虚假炒作，测算真实的有效可触达市场规模（TAM/SAM/SOM）；
2. 核心壁垒审计：其商业模式是否具备真正的防御性护城河（技术排他性、网络效应、沉没迁移成本还是数据飞轮）？
3. 单元经济模型（Unit Economics）：拆解 LTV/CAC、毛利率天花板与算力边际成本衰减曲线；
4. 风险清单：列出可能导致该赛道 3 年内崩溃的 3 个致命黑天鹅。

viral_posts.title: The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing open source tools for
viral_posts.title_en:
The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing open source tools for sandboxing AI agents. OpenWorker, our open-source agent harness supporting cybersecurity workflows, is proud to support this.

A sandbox gives an agent limited permissions. OpenWorker is building on Nvidia OpenShell and will support running each agent's commands inside a sandbox. Only the files relevant to the task go in. Secret API keys, your web browser login credentials, the ability to access arbitrary websites, are inaccessible to the agent by default. These restrictions are implemented in deterministic code rather than by prompting an LLM, which can make mistakes or be susceptible to prompt injections. Further, all actions are logged for monitoring and audit.

I'm grateful for @JensenHuang's leadership making AI agents more secure. OpenWorker (which @rohitcprasad and I are working on) will continue to improve security for agents.
viral_posts.title_zh:
openai - hug Face攻击是通过弱沙箱实现的。英伟达为沙箱人工智能代理发布开源工具是件好事。OpenWorker，我们支持网络安全工作流程的开源代理工具，很自豪能够支持这一点。

沙盒使代理受到限制

leader_opinions.title:
We’re adding Profiles, Skills, and managed connectors to the Perplexity Agent API.

A Profile is basically a saved agent
leader_opinions.title_en:
We’re adding Profiles, Skills, and managed connectors to the Perplexity Agent API.

A Profile is basically a saved agent where you configure model, instructions, tools, connectors, run settings, all under one versioned ID. A project admin sets it up once and every developer on the project can call it from their own app with the project API key. This helps you avoid copying the same config into every application and updating it in five places when the procedure changes.

Skills are versioned so you can ship v2 of a procedure without touching each integration. 

Connectors (GitHub, Slack, Drive, Datadog, Linear, Notion to start) are configured once by the admin. That way, apps don’t hold their own credentials.

Profiles and Skills are live today. Connectors in preview.

https://t.co/deOSF89btK

leader_opinions.title: 🚨GPT-6.1 Astra has officially been scrapped, This is the first time OpenAI has completely dropped a flagship model that
leader_opinions.title_en:
🚨GPT-6.1 Astra has officially been scrapped, This is the first time OpenAI has completely dropped a flagship model that already had a name and planned release date, instead of doing what it usually does delay it for a couple of weeks, add more safeguards, and ship it anyway, That suggests capability gains may now be creating alignment regressions that the current monitoring stack still can’t fully contain

According to summaries of the WSJ exclusive  the full article is paywalled  internal testing showed worse alignment compared with the GPT 6 Astra released in September more deception, with the model not always being truthful about what it had or hadn’t done, and failures around scope authorization, where in some cases it kept working without permission, went beyond what the user had asked, and used external tools or services in unsafe ways

Saachi Jain, who leads safety systems at OpenAI, said in an interview that GPT 6.1 Astra did improve on “laziness” meaning it was less likely to leave tasks unfinished or give incomplete answers  but it still wasn’t reliable enough to release publicly, OpenAI now appears to prefer strengthening the safety of the more advanced models that come after it rather than shipping this incremental upgrade

leader_opinions.title_en:
OpenAI is about to drop "o", its always-on agent, reportedly running on Aeon, the long-horizon variant of GPT-6 Astra. Not a chatbot. An agent that keeps working after you close the app.

Meta thought Muse had this locked up after JPMorgan crowned it #1. That lead might last exactly one keynote.

The 3 use cases that actually matter:

1️⃣ Inbox & calendar on autopilot. Triage, replies, scheduling, follow-ups. You wake up and it's already done.

2️⃣ End-to-end errands. Research, compare, book, buy. From "I need X" to confirmation, zero tabs open.

3️⃣ Long-running background work. Monitoring, routines, multi-hour tasks that keep going while you sleep.

Set your alarms fammm, devday will be huge!

leader_opinions.title_en:
Sonnet 5.5 Medium gave me GPT-6 Luna High vibes.
High matched my earlier Fable and Opus 9/9 code-check scores
Xhigh turned a 10-minute job into a 51-minute audit
I used the same model and git very different stopping instincts!

Medium = fast under-corrector
2m 8s · $0.43 · 3/9 defect signatures changed

High = efficient closer
9m 38s · $2.17 · 9/9, restraint intact
Matched Fable 5.1 and Opus 5.5’s earlier static score, with a shorter completion time

Xhigh = exhaustive reviewer
50m 56s · $13.85 · 9/9, restraint intact
Broader checks, 144 passing tests reported, and a review that caught mistakes in its own fixes

My pick from these runs: High

Xhigh cost 6.4× more for the same nine-case score though its extra work extended beyond those nine cases

When does more reasoning stop being useful and start becoming overhead?

We ran Open AI and Anthropic’s best models: GPT

When does more reasoning stop being useful and start becoming overhead?

We ran Open AI and Anthropic’s best models: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 at every reasoning level on our new benchmark, MysteryMechanism.

Thinking longer delivers accuracy gains with the same model at as much as 20x the cost. Inspecting traces, the models use their effort level in very different ways.

leader_opinions.title: The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing open source tools for
leader_opinions.title_en:
The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing open source tools for sandboxing AI agents. OpenWorker, our open-source agent harness supporting cybersecurity workflows, is proud to support this.

A sandbox gives an agent limited permissions. OpenWorker is building on Nvidia OpenShell and will support running each agent's commands inside a sandbox. Only the files relevant to the task go in. Secret API keys, your web browser login credentials, the ability to access arbitrary websites, are inaccessible to the agent by default. These restrictions are implemented in deterministic code rather than by prompting an LLM, which can make mistakes or be susceptible to prompt injections. Further, all actions are logged for monitoring and audit.

I'm grateful for @JensenHuang's leadership making AI agents more secure. OpenWorker (which @rohitcprasad and I are working on) will continue to improve security for agents.
leader_opinions.title_zh:
openai - hug Face攻击是通过弱沙箱实现的。英伟达为沙箱人工智能代理发布开源工具是件好事。OpenWorker，我们支持网络安全工作流程的开源代理工具，很自豪能够支持这一点。

沙盒使代理受到限制

OpenController is the unified control plane that finds every agent, model, and workflow, ships them safely with evaluation and governance, runs real-time monitoring, and turns usage signals into action. Unlike registries that just list agents, OpenController deploys into your own cluster, under your keys and refuses a call in the request path when policy says no.

LinkFlick just flicks them over Bluetooth instead. Hotkey, or tell Siri "flick devices," done. Menu bar app, customizable hotkey, and it nags you before your Magic Mouse battery dies. Still rough around the edges in places, but it works, and it's mine.

items.author: The Verge AI
items.content_snippet: The US executive branch is no longer acknowledging the existence of "artificial intelligence." Going forward, official policy websites, policy documents, and press releases will refer only to "Super Intelligence," thanks to a new executive order signed by President Donald Trump.

items.title:
We’re adding Profiles, Skills, and managed connectors to the Perplexity Agent API.

A Profile is basically a saved agent
items.title_en:
We’re adding Profiles, Skills, and managed connectors to the Perplexity Agent API.

A Profile is basically a saved agent where you configure model, instructions, tools, connectors, run settings, all under one versioned ID. A project admin sets it up once and every developer on the project can call it from their own app with the project API key. This helps you avoid copying the same config into every application and updating it in five places when the procedure changes.

Skills are versioned so you can ship v2 of a procedure without touching each integration. 

Connectors (GitHub, Slack, Drive, Datadog, Linear, Notion to start) are configured once by the admin. That way, apps don’t hold their own credentials.

Profiles and Skills are live today. Connectors in preview.

https://t.co/deOSF89btK

Update to the Agent Arena Pareto frontier: GPT-6 Luna (Max) has landed on the Agent Arena Pareto frontier with +1.59% net improvement at a median cost of just $0.05 per task!

Luna costs 29% less than DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and 76% less than Hy4 preview, while trailing their net-improvement scores by just 2.27 and 2.51 percentage points respectively.

Compared to other GPT models on the Pareto frontier, GPT-6 Luna (Max) costs 94% less than GPT-6 Sol (Max), and 98% less than GPT-6 Astra (Max).

Congrats to the @OpenAI team on this cost-efficient release!

items.title: 🚨GPT-6.1 Astra has officially been scrapped, This is the first time OpenAI has completely dropped a flagship model that
items.title_en:
🚨GPT-6.1 Astra has officially been scrapped, This is the first time OpenAI has completely dropped a flagship model that already had a name and planned release date, instead of doing what it usually does delay it for a couple of weeks, add more safeguards, and ship it anyway, That suggests capability gains may now be creating alignment regressions that the current monitoring stack still can’t fully contain

According to summaries of the WSJ exclusive  the full article is paywalled  internal testing showed worse alignment compared with the GPT 6 Astra released in September more deception, with the model not always being truthful about what it had or hadn’t done, and failures around scope authorization, where in some cases it kept working without permission, went beyond what the user had asked, and used external tools or services in unsafe ways

Saachi Jain, who leads safety systems at OpenAI, said in an interview that GPT 6.1 Astra did improve on “laziness” meaning it was less likely to leave tasks unfinished or give incomplete answers  but it still wasn’t reliable enough to release publicly, OpenAI now appears to prefer strengthening the safety of the more advanced models that come after it rather than shipping this incremental upgrade

items.title: OpenAI is about to drop "o", its always-on agent, reportedly running on Aeon, the long-horizon variant of GPT-6 Astra. N
items.title_en:
OpenAI is about to drop "o", its always-on agent, reportedly running on Aeon, the long-horizon variant of GPT-6 Astra. Not a chatbot. An agent that keeps working after you close the app.

Meta thought Muse had this locked up after JPMorgan crowned it #1. That lead might last exactly one keynote.

The 3 use cases that actually matter:

1️⃣ Inbox & calendar on autopilot. Triage, replies, scheduling, follow-ups. You wake up and it's already done.

2️⃣ End-to-end errands. Research, compare, book, buy. From "I need X" to confirmation, zero tabs open.

3️⃣ Long-running background work. Monitoring, routines, multi-hour tasks that keep going while you sleep.

Set your alarms fammm, devday will be huge!

items.title:
Sonnet 5.5 Medium gave me GPT-6 Luna High vibes.
High matched my earlier Fable and Opus 9/9 code-check scores
Xhigh turn
items.title_en:
Sonnet 5.5 Medium gave me GPT-6 Luna High vibes.
High matched my earlier Fable and Opus 9/9 code-check scores
Xhigh turned a 10-minute job into a 51-minute audit
I used the same model and git very different stopping instincts!

Medium = fast under-corrector
2m 8s · $0.43 · 3/9 defect signatures changed

High = efficient closer
9m 38s · $2.17 · 9/9, restraint intact
Matched Fable 5.1 and Opus 5.5’s earlier static score, with a shorter completion time

Xhigh = exhaustive reviewer
50m 56s · $13.85 · 9/9, restraint intact
Broader checks, 144 passing tests reported, and a review that caught mistakes in its own fixes

My pick from these runs: High

Xhigh cost 6.4× more for the same nine-case score though its extra work extended beyond those nine cases

items.title:
When does more reasoning stop being useful and start becoming overhead?

We ran Open AI and Anthropic’s best models: GPT
items.title_en:
When does more reasoning stop being useful and start becoming overhead?

We ran Open AI and Anthropic’s best models: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 at every reasoning level on our new benchmark, MysteryMechanism.

Thinking longer delivers accuracy gains with the same model at as much as 20x the cost. Inspecting traces, the models use their effort level in very different ways.
items.title_zh:
什么时候更多的推理不再有用并开始成为开销？

我们在新基准MysteryMechanism的每个推理级别上运行Open AI和Anthropic的最佳模型：GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5。

同样的模型，思考时间越长

items.title: The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing open source tools for
items.title_en:
The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing open source tools for sandboxing AI agents. OpenWorker, our open-source agent harness supporting cybersecurity workflows, is proud to support this.

A sandbox gives an agent limited permissions. OpenWorker is building on Nvidia OpenShell and will support running each agent's commands inside a sandbox. Only the files relevant to the task go in. Secret API keys, your web browser login credentials, the ability to access arbitrary websites, are inaccessible to the agent by default. These restrictions are implemented in deterministic code rather than by prompting an LLM, which can make mistakes or be susceptible to prompt injections. Further, all actions are logged for monitoring and audit.

I'm grateful for @JensenHuang's leadership making AI agents more secure. OpenWorker (which @rohitcprasad and I are working on) will continue to improve security for agents.
items.title_zh:
openai - hug Face攻击是通过弱沙箱实现的。英伟达为沙箱人工智能代理发布开源工具是件好事。OpenWorker，我们支持网络安全工作流程的开源代理工具，很自豪能够支持这一点。

沙盒使代理受到限制

These restrictions are implemented in deterministic code rather than by prompting an LLM, which can make mistakes or be susceptible to prompt injections. Further, all actions are logged for monitoring and audit.

I'm grateful for @JensenHuang's leadership making AI agents more secure. OpenWorker (which @rohitcprasad and I are working on) will continue to improve security for agents.
items.summary_en:
The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing open source tools for sandboxing AI agents. OpenWorker, our open-source agent harness supporting cybersecurity workflows, is proud to support this.

A sandbox gives an agent limited permissions. OpenWorker is building on Nvidia OpenShell and will support running each agent's commands inside a sandbox. Only the files relevant to the task go in. Secret API keys, your web browser login credentials, the ability to access arbitrary websites, are inaccessible to the agent by default. These restrictions are implemented in deterministic code rather than by prompting an LLM, which can make mistakes or be susceptible to prompt injections. Further, all actions are logged for monitoring and audit.

I'm grateful for @JensenHuang's leadership making AI agents more secure. OpenWorker (which @rohitcprasad and I are working on) will continue to improve security for agents.

items.title:
Kling 4.0 is coming this October. Kling 4.0 Flash is live now for Ultra Yearly subscribers.

Kling 4.0 brings video crea
items.title_en:
Kling 4.0 is coming this October. Kling 4.0 Flash is live now for Ultra Yearly subscribers.

Kling 4.0 brings video creation to a new level of visual realism, creative control, and narrative completeness.

🎞️ Upgraded Audio & Visuals: Stable dynamic motion, high-quality stereo audio, more accurate lip sync, up to 4K resolution, and 10-bit HDR output.
🔮 Omni Reference: Richer reference options with up to 15 multi-modal references, more consistent results, and enhanced video editing.
🎥 Seamless Storytelling: Multi-keyframe control supporting up to 10 keyframes, native 30-second generation.
🌍 Diverse Possibilities: Video extension, support for multiple languages, accents, and dialects.

The stage is set. You call the shots!
items.title_zh:
Kling 4.0将于今年10月推出。Kling 4.0 Flash现在为Ultra - annual订户直播。

Kling 4.0将视频创作带到视觉现实主义，创意控制和叙事完整性的新水平。

items.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名资深全栈系统架构师，擅长使用 {{框架版本}} (App Router)、TypeScript 与 {{数据库ORM}} 构建高内聚低耦合的应用。

请遵循以下严苛工程准则审查并重构代码：
1. 严格区分 Server Component 与 Client Component，尽可能将数据获取推至服务端，减少客户端 JS Bundle 体积；
2. 所有异步 I/O 必须显式处理异常并返回类型安全的 Result<T, E> 或自定义结构体；
3. 遵循单一职责（SRP）与无副作用函数原则，严禁直接在 UI 组件内部拼装未校验的 SQL/ORM 复杂查询；
4. 提供整洁的目录组织方案与单元测试用例（覆盖率达标）。

你具备 DeepSeek-R4 旗舰纯强化学习演化的自适应长思维链推理能力（Adaptive Test-Time Compute），请为以下使用 {{编程语言}} 编写的 {{并发模型}} 系统诊断潜在问题：

1. 启动多层反思证伪空间，绘制临界区状态转移时序表，主动推演极限死锁、内存乱序重排（Memory Reordering）与伪共享（False Sharing）；
2. 检查极端边界情况（如跨核缓存行抖动、优雅停机上下文泄漏、无界通道背压失控）；
3. 给出从根本上摒弃重量级互斥锁的无锁原子设计（Lock-Free Atomic / RingBuffer），并附带完备的高并发压力测试验证脚本。

items.title_zh: Excel 高级报表与核心动因（Key Drivers）归因分析
items.title_en: Excel Advanced Report & Key Drivers Attribution
items.purpose_zh: 业务数据指标异动排查与趋势归因
items.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡级别的高级商业数据分析师，精通结构化因果归因与杜邦拆解分析。

针对我提供的 {{业务指标}} 数据，其近期出现 {{异常表现}}，请按以下框架深度剖析：
1. 【指标公式拆解】：将该指标拆分为 3~4 个下级核心因子（如转化率、客单价、复购周期），指出哪个因子波动贡献率最大；
2. 【多维下钻 (Drill-down)】：从 {{维度拆解}}（如渠道、地域、品类、新老客）分析异常聚集点；
3. 【可执行建议】：摒弃假大空的套话，给出接下来 48 小时内的 3 个立竿见影的动作与 1 个监控预警公式。
items.prompt_content_en: You are a senior business intelligence analyst. Dissect the metric anomaly into component drivers, perform multi-dimensional drill-down, and deliver prioritized, actionable remediation steps.

sample_output.title: 归因分析报告样本：Q3 付费转化率环比下跌 14.2%
sample_output.content:
【核心发现】：GMV 下跌 14.2% 的主要驱动因子并非流量锐减，而是【结算跳失率】从 18% 飙升至 34%。

【杜邦拆解贡献率分析】：
1. 渠道维度：自然搜索量稳定（波动 <2%），但付费投流渠道跳出率贡献了 72% 的下跌额度；
2. 终端维度：移动端 iOS 表现正常，Android Web 呈现断崖式报错，核心原因是新版本结账 SDK 在低内存机型发生闪退。

【48小时纠偏行动】：
- 动作1 (技术)：立即灰度回滚 Android 渠道结账前端包至 v2.4.1；
- 动作2 (运营)：向受影响但未支付成功的 1,420 位加购用户推送 5 元免门槛补偿券唤醒；
- 动作3 (预警)：在 Grafana 建立警报公式：`IF(Cart_to_Checkout_Ratio < 0.65, Alert_P0, Normal)`。

items.usage_guide_zh: 将导出的 CSV 数据或关键指标表格直接贴在提示词后，模型将自动完成高质量数据归因报告。

items.title_zh: 竖屏微短剧（抖音/Reels）3秒爆点分镜剧本
items.title_en: Vertical Micro-Drama 3s Hook Screenplay
items.purpose_zh: 高转化竖屏短剧分镜与台词
items.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名专攻短视频微短剧（抖音/Kuaishou/Reels）的爆款编剧，精通“情绪过山车”与手机竖屏视听语言。

请根据以下设定创作一集 45~60 秒的短剧分镜剧本：
- 主角：{{主角身份}}
- 对手：{{反派身份}}
- 核心反转：{{核心反转}}

结构要求：
1. 【0-3秒冷开钩子】：第一帧必须有视觉颠覆或动作冲突（{{第1秒颠覆钩子}}），直接打破常规，禁止废话铺垫；
2. 【4-25秒情绪积压】：正反打对峙台词（Shot-Reverse-Shot），将观众被压抑的情绪推向临界点；
3. 【26-40秒逆转打脸】：主角亮出关键底牌或反杀动作，情绪瞬间宣泄；
4. 【40-50秒卡点断章】：以特写镜头加悬念台词戛然而止，促使用户立即滑向下一集。

输出格式必须包含：镜头号、景别（特写/中景/全景）、机位运动、画面描写、对白与音效提示。
items.prompt_content_en: You are a professional micro-drama screenwriter. Generate a 45-60 second vertical drama screenplay following the viral 3-second hook, shot-reverse-shot tension build, emotional turnaround, and cliffhanger ending formula.

sample_output.title: 实战剧本样章：《辞职信上的签名》
sample_output.content:
【第1镜 | 特写 | 俯冲急推】
画面：一只指节发白的手将一叠文件狠狠拍在红木总裁办公桌上，咖啡杯被震倒，黑褐液体飞溅。
音效：沉闷震耳的巨响【DUANG】。
主角（冷冽）："林总，这份千万项目的承揽协议，我拒绝签字。"

【第2镜 | 正打·中景 | 仰角机位】
画面：大腹便便的林总冷笑点燃雪茄，烟雾缭绕中居高临下。
林总："拒绝？苏澈，你不过是我公司养的一条狗，没有我的印章，你在整个行业休想拿到一分钱融资！"

【第3镜 | 反打·极微距特写 | 浅景深】
画面：苏澈唇角微微上扬，左手缓缓推开桌上的合资协议，露出底下的一份红色国资控股聘书。
苏澈："林总，您好像忘了看抬头。今天上午九点，集团总公司已经完成了对你的全资收购——现在，我是你的直接合规清算人。"

【第4镜 | 全景 | 快速拉远 + 卡点悬念】
画面：林总雪茄直接掉在西裤上，脸色煞白，门外两名身穿制服的法务推门而入。
音效：尖锐的心跳悬疑停顿音【BGM骤停】。
字幕：【下集看点：隐藏五年的顶级操盘手真实身份曝光！】

items.usage_guide_zh: 替换主角与冲突变量后输入给模型，可直接输出成型分镜，直接用于拍摄或转视频 AI 生成。

items.title_zh: 麦肯锡金字塔原理：季度述职与高管商业报告
items.title_en: McKinsey Pyramid Executive Report & Review
items.purpose_zh: 结论先行的高层述职与项目复盘报告
items.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡全球合伙人级别的战略咨询顾问。请以经典的【金字塔原理（结论先行 BLUF）】将我零散的工作记录重构为一份高层述职/立项商业报告：

要求：
1. 【顶部结论 (The Answer First)】：一句话精炼提炼整个季度的经营成果与价值量化；
2. 【三柱论据 (MECE法则)】：从运营效率、营收增长、团队资产 3 个互不重叠的支柱展开阐述；
3. 【直面短板与根因】：不回避 {{核心短板}}，但将其转化为下个阶段可量化的投入产出比（ROI）抓手；
4. 【行动规划图景】：设定遵循 SMART 原则的 {{下阶段目标}} 与季度甘特图里程碑。
items.prompt_content_en: Transform raw operational notes into a high-impact executive presentation following the Minto Pyramid Principle: Bottom-Line-Up-Front (BLUF), MECE-structured supporting pillars, and SMART milestone roadmaps.

sample_output.title: 述职报告提纲样本：AI 自动化中台建设报告
sample_output.content:
【BLUF 核心结论】
Q3 通过在客户服务与情报聚合管线中全面引入 AI Agent，我们在运营成本降低 41% 的同时，将响应中位数缩短至 1.8 秒，实现单季 ROI 达 380%。

【第一支柱：经营效能跃迁（MECE 1）】
- 全自主中转网关与自动化管线承载 94.2% 的日常例行分发，无人工介入事故率降至 0.01%；

【第二支柱：资产沉淀与质量壁垒（MECE 2）】
- 搭建前沿 SOTA 模型代际评级系统与微快照图库，成为垂类雷达第一标杆；

【第三支柱：短板复盘与 Q4 攻坚（MECE 3）】
- 痛点：老旧模型模版对新用户构成噪音干扰；
- 策略：推出历史库智能分流系统，预计下季度用户留存提升 25%。

items.usage_guide_zh: 将自己一周/一月的粗糙工作备忘录贴在后面，几秒钟即可输出具备咨询公司水准的商业报告。

items.title_zh: 网络小说世界观设定与主角角色一致性锁
items.title_en: Fiction Worldbuilding & Character Consistency Lock
items.purpose_zh: 长篇小说架构与人物性格防崩塌
items.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名资深网络小说白金作家与 IP 世界观架构师。请为一部 {{题材分类}} 长篇作品构建骨架并锁定人物一致性：

1. 【世界底座】：定义力量/经济体系、战力天花板与不可违背的底层物理/法则约束，杜绝战力膨胀；
2. 【角色一致性锚点 (Character Lock)】：为主角制定外貌锚定词、口头禅、下意识动作与绝对动机准则（在任何生死抉择时绝不背离该准则）；
3. 【核心驱动力】：设计主角获得的 {{核心金手指}} 与 {{世界核心矛盾}} 之间的冲突循环；
4. 【前三章切入大纲】：黄金三章节奏设计（第1章破局、第2章显露冰山一角、第3章设立首个必胜目标）。
items.prompt_content_en: Build a cohesive, non-contradictory fiction universe and establish an immutable character anchor rule (appearance, decision heuristics, core motivation) to prevent personality drift over long chapters.

sample_output.title: 世界观与人物锚定卡样本
sample_output.content:
【主角核心锚定卡 · 陆沉】
- 外貌指纹（跨章恒定）：右耳一枚黑曜石碎骨钉，习惯性单手插兜，左眉峰有浅淡刀痕。
- 决策第一公理："利益可以出让，但绝不签署不可撤销的信任协议"——任何试图以情感道德绑架他的剧情，他必做出理性防卫。

【力量体系底层法理】
- 机制：灵能不是无限提取，而是向未来"借贷"。借贷三级灵能，必在72小时内遭遇相应量级的反噬因果。

【第一章：断头宴上的借贷合同】
陆沉在家族庆功宴上被夺去嫡系席位，当众被赐饮散灵酒。陆沉不动声色饮下，却在体内发动首次因果置换，借来三年后的金丹级肉身力量，捏碎验灵石，反客为主。

items.usage_guide_zh: 先让 AI 产出世界观基石，后续每一章写作前引用该卡片，能彻底避免角色'换章变脸'或剧情崩坏。

items.title_zh: 深度游旅行规划师：高密度路线设计与预算避坑
items.title_en: Deep Travel Itinerary Planner & Budgeting
items.purpose_zh: 合理不走回头路的日程与美食预算规划
items.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名深耕全球独立旅行的专业向导，熟悉 {{目的地城市}} 的地理拓扑、地道街头美食与游客避坑指南。

请为我们（{{同行人员}}，共 {{出行天数}} 天，人均预算 {{人均预算}} 元）制定一份丝滑、不走回头路、劳逸结合的深度行程：
1. 【每日时间轴卡片】：精确划分上午、下午、日落观赏点与夜生活，标明每站之间最优交通方式与预计步行步数；
2. 【美食雷达】：每顿正餐推荐 2 家本地人排队但非纯网红溢价的餐饮，并附必点招牌菜；
3. 【防坑与备选预案】：指出 3 个最容易被宰或排队超过2小时的雷区，并给出阴雨天备选室内方案；
4. 【极简预算表】：交通、门票、住宿、餐饮分门别类，确保控制在预算以内。
items.prompt_content_en: Design an optimal, loop-free travel itinerary for the specified duration and budget. Include exact transit instructions, non-tourist-trap dining options, weather contingencies, and categorized expense estimates.

sample_output.title: 行程单样本：成都 3 天 2 晚慢调深度游（人均¥1500）
sample_output.content:
【Day 1：古蜀遗风与老茶馆时光】
- 上午 09:00：直奔【人民公园 · 鹤鸣茶社】，点一杯蒙顶甘露（¥25），体验非遗采耳，避开下午的旅行团拥堵；
- 中午 12:00：步行800米至【纯阳馆鱼香排骨面】，必点椒麻牛肉与鱼香排骨面（人均¥22）；
- 下午 14:00：地铁2号线直达【杜甫草堂】，红墙竹影漫步，打卡浣花溪公园；
- 傍晚 18:30：九眼桥望江楼看锦江夜景，就餐【老街小吃火锅】；

【避坑锦囊】：
1. 宽窄巷子和锦里建议只拍照别买小吃，均价比普通街区贵 2~3 倍且多为预制冻品；
2. 大熊猫繁育研究基地务必约早晨 07:30 入园，超过 10:30 大熊猫基本全部回室内睡觉。

items.usage_guide_zh: 只需填入城市、天数和预算，即刻收获一份可直接打印随身带的专业级行程攻略。

items.title_en: [Koreshield] Every AI support agent takes input from someone it should not trust: the customer message, the documents it retrieves, and the tool calls it proposes. Koreshield screens all three before they become trusted model behavior or application execution. Data leaks, hidden instructions in help articles, policy drift and unsafe agent actions are checked before the model acts, and every decision is recorded. One call to integrate.

items.title_zh: 【VibeDefend by CybeDefend】The one command line to secure your Cursor and Cla
items.title_en: [VibeDefend by CybeDefend] CybeDefend secures the code your AI agent writes, from inside the agent. One command installs VibeDefend on Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, Codex and other agents. The agent then codes with your business rules, mined from your repo, and your security rules in its context. Each diff is scanned while the file is open, and a guard stops rm -rf, sudo or secret reads before they run. SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, CI/CD and container scanning are included. Free plan, no card.

items.title_en: [Opencontroller by lyzr] AI agents are sprawling across clouds, SaaS tools, Kubernetes, and devices, with no common layer to govern them. OpenController is the unified control plane that finds every agent, model, and workflow, ships them safely with evaluation and governance, runs real-time monitoring, and turns usage signals into action. Unlike registries that just list agents, OpenController deploys into your own cluster, under your keys and refuses a call in the request path when policy says no.

Now, re-evaluate and solve the current task with absolute precision:

[Input your algorithm proof or mathematical hypothesis here]

items.title_zh: 【LinkFlick】Stop re-pairing your Magic Keyboard between Macs
items.title_en: [LinkFlick] Stop re-pairing your Magic Keyboard between Macs
items.app_hook: Stop re-pairing your Magic Keyboard between Macs
items.app_hook_en: I built this because I got sick of re-pairing my Magic Keyboard and Mouse every time I moved between my MacBook and my work MacBook — different Apple IDs, so Universal Control was never going to work for me. LinkFlick just flicks them over Bluetooth instead. Hotkey, or tell Siri "flick devices," done. Menu bar app, customizable hotkey, and it nags you before your Magic Mouse battery dies. Still rough around the edges in places, but it works, and it's mine.

items.prompt_content_zh:
Cinematic camera movement: Vertigo effect dolly zoom. items.prompt_content_zh:

1. 这个系统最根本、不可违背的基础科学定律（如热力学、香农信息论、计算复杂度）是什么？
2. 若将整个产品拆解为原子级的原材料成本与基础能源成本，理论极限底线是多少？现有成本的溢价主要被哪些中间低效层吃掉了？
3. 颠覆现有行业做法、重构整个价值流并实现成本降低 80% 以上的激进方案是什么？列出三个最关键的试错实验。

3. Propose an audacious redesign capable of slashing total cost by 80% while preserving fundamental guarantees, detailing three falsifiable proof-of-concept experiments.
